description: Business impressions on Google Maps on Desktop. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count (Performance API DailyMetric).
Business impressions on Google Search on Desktop. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.
Business impressions on Google Maps on Mobile. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.

Business impressions on Google Search on Mobile. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count. Total impressions = sum of the 4 BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_* metrics (Google exposes no single combined metric).
Number of message conversations received on the business profile. Additive daily count.
Number of times directions to the business location were requested. Additive daily count.
Number of times the call button was clicked. Additive daily count.
Number of times the website link was clicked. Additive daily count.
Number of bookings made from the profile via Reserve with Google. Additive daily count.
Number of food orders received from the profile. Additive daily count.
Number of clicks to view/interact with menu content. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.
Reporting day (YYYY-MM-DD), from the Performance API datedValues[].date. Daily grain. Zero-days may be omitted by the API and are gap-filled to 0 by the connector.

The reporting entity: Business Profile location id (resource name locations/{location_id}). Stamped on every row; the Performance and Reviews endpoints are scoped by this id. Discovered via Account Management accounts.list -> Business Information accounts.locations.list.
Business Profile account id (accounts/{account_id}) owning the location. Structural; planned (not extracted into the daily fact by v1).
Human-readable location name (Business Information Location.title). Label for the location_id. Planned.
A search term users typed to find the business (searchkeywords.impressions.monthly). MONTHLY granularity only -- a separate monthly fact, never merged with the daily metrics stream. Planned.

Monthly impression count for a search keyword. Union insightsValue.{value|threshold}: threshold = a floor for low-volume keywords (e.g. '<15') Google will not report exactly -- model as nullable/threshold-flagged. MONTHLY, additive within a month. Planned.
Encrypted unique review id (legacy My Business API v4 accounts.locations.reviews.list). Planned (v4 allowlist-gated).
Review star rating enum: STAR_RATING_UNSPECIFIED, ONE, TWO, THREE, FOUR, FIVE. Planned (v4-gated). The derived average rating is NON-ADDITIVE.
Review free-text body. Planned (v4-gated).
Review creation timestamp (RFC 3339). Planned (v4-gated).
Reviewer display name (only when reviewer.isAnonymous=false). Planned (v4-gated).
Owner reply text to the review (<=4096 bytes). Planned (v4-gated).
Location average star rating (reviews.list aggregate). NON-ADDITIVE (an average -- never summed). Planned (v4-gated).
Location total review count (reviews.list aggregate). Point-in-time count. Planned (v4-gated).
